observation: The benchmark reader must sum input_tokens alone for Codex usage events. The cached_input_tokens number is a subset, so adding it again inflates totals.
A note whose only anchor is a generated coverage report must be rejected. Build and run artifacts are temporary; use the source that creates the report as its dependency instead.
When an AST-hashed dependency is checked by a teammate without tree-sitter, compare a stored secondary regex hash. Different extraction engines must not make unchanged code appear stale.

The store now reports a diagnostic naming a shared note file that contains git merge markers, rather than silently ignoring it. The conflicted note is still excluded from lookup until its JSON is repaired.
Maintenance is protected by a timestamped lock; another invocation within its lock window returns skipped:locked instead of running a second batch.

Reviews remain read-only with respect to knowledge notes. A new cleanup command removes local review evidence artifacts older than 30 days but must never remove, retire, or rewrite the knowledge notes used in those reviews.

Codex cached_input_tokens is already inside input_tokens and must not be added again. The dashboard must also keep generated output tokens in a separate counter instead of labelling the combined total as input.
The artifact download service adds byte-range request support so clients can resume interrupted downloads of compiled bundles.
Streaming audio resampling must retain fractional phase between chunks; resetting phase on every packet causes audible clicks at packet boundaries.
